description:
**Company Description** 
 Springfit Mattresses \& Sleep Systems is one of India’s most trusted premium mattress manufacturers, with over 40 years of experience in luxury sleep solutions. The company combines advanced sleep science, precision engineering, and continuous R\&D to create mattresses that support better health, productivity, and overall well\-being. Its product portfolio spans orthopedic spring, memory foam, gel\-infused, latex mattresses, available in multiple sizes and customizable formats. Springfit operates world\-class production facilities in India.
 



  





**Role Description** 
 This is a full\-time, on\-site Performance Marketer role based in Ghaziabad. The Performance Marketer will plan, execute, and optimize paid marketing campaigns across digital channels such as search, social, display, and marketplaces to drive traffic, conversions, and ROI. Responsibilities include managing ad budgets, setting up tracking and reporting, analyzing campaign performance data, and making data\-driven recommendations to improve results. The role involves collaborating with brand, creative, and e\-commerce teams to align messaging, landing pages, and offers with performance goals, while running A/B tests and experiments to enhance customer acquisition and retention. The Performance Marketer will also monitor industry trends and competitor activity, ensuring Springfit’s online presence remains strong and growth\-focused.
 



  





**Qualifications** 



* Strong performance marketing skills with hands\-on experience in paid search, paid social, display advertising, and marketplace ads (e.g., Google Ads, Meta Ads).
* Proficiency in analytics and optimization, including campaign tracking, A/B testing, conversion rate optimization, and using tools such as Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager, and reporting dashboards.
* Experience in digital marketing strategy, including audience segmentation, funnel design, remarketing strategies, and integrating performance efforts with broader brand and content initiatives.
* Ability to collaborate on creatives and messaging with design and content teams to improve ad performance, landing page effectiveness, and overall user experience.
* Strong quantitative and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to interpret data, present insights, and make clear recommendations to stakeholders.
* Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field; relevant certifications in performance or digital marketing are an advantage.
* Experience in D2C or e\-commerce, preferably in consumer products, home, lifestyle, or similar categories, is beneficial.
* Comfort working on\-site in Ghaziabad, with the ability to collaborate cross\-functionally in a fast\-paced, growth\-oriented environment.

title: India Sustainability Certification Auditor
description:
RINA is currently recruiting for a
 **India Sustainability Certification Auditor** 
 to join its office in Delhi/Ghaziabad within the
 **International Certification** 
 Division.
   

  

**Mission**
 The role focuses on reviewing various documents, conducting audits, identifying findings, and contributing to the certification process related to the different certification schemes.
   

  

**Key Accountabilities**
 Document Review:
   

  

 Check customer management system documents, including manuals, procedures, instructions, files, records, and technical documents, to ensure compliance with standards and regulations.
   

  

 Audit Participation:
   

  

 Participate in and conduct audits, which involves conducting interviews, taking comprehensive notes, and evaluating the implementation of management systems.
   

  

 Audit Result Definition:
   

  

 Identify and define audit results (Positive and negative findings as non conformities, opportunity of improvement).
   

  

 Technical Review:
   

  

 Carry out a technical review of audit files, providing insights and recommendations for certification decisions.
   

  

 Skill Maintenance:
   

  

 Keep skills, qualifications, and certifications up to date by staying informed about industry standards, regulations, and best practices.
   

  

 Data Management:
   

  

 Maintain updated records of customer data and other information relevant to the audit process.
   

  

 Customer Focus:
   

  

 Demonstrate a strong customer focus by understanding and responding to customer requests and needs.
   

  

 Strive for high customer satisfaction by ensuring the quality and effectiveness of audit activities.
   

  

**Education**
 Bachelor’s Degree in Agriculture/Agronomy/Food Technology or Business Administration Finance Management
   

  

**Qualifications**
* Strong interest in FSC\-CoC Verification and Certification activities.
* Strong interest in quality management systems, compliance, and certification processes.
* Basic understanding of auditing principles and standards (e.g., ISO 9001, ISO 14001, etc.).
* Ability to analyze documents and assess compliance with established standards.
* Attention to detail and strong organizational skills.
* Good communication skills to conduct interviews and report findings.
* Willingness to learn and develop expertise in audit techniques and certification requirements.
* Proficiency in MS Office and basic knowledge of audit management software.
* Ability to work effectively in teams and handle various assignments.
* Adaptability and eagerness to gain industry\-specific knowledge.


**Competencies**
* WORKPLACE DYNAMICS \- Resourcefulness in shaping progress and working efficiently.
* PERSONAL EMPOWERMENT \- Ownership for life, work and results, striving to grow professionally and personally.
* INTERPERSONAL INFLUENCE \- Skills and strategies we use to interact effectively with others.
* DOMAIN \& BUSINESS ACUMEN \- Applying a scientific approach and critical thinking in operations and solution development within area of expertise.
* FORESIGHT \& INSIGHT \- Context awareness adopting a systemic perspective and informed decision making.


 RINA is a multinational company providing a wide range of services in the energy, marine, certification, infrastructure \& mobility, industry, research \& development sectors. Our business model covers the full process of project development, from concept to completion.
   

  

*At RINA, we endeavor to create a work environment where every single person is valued and encouraged to develop new ideas. We provide equal employment opportunities and are committed to creating a workplace where everyone feels respected and safe from discrimination or harassment of any kind. We are also compliant to the Italian Law n. 68/99\.*

title: Linkedin Growth Intern
description:
**Company Description** 
 TalesByDora (TBD) is a travel\-focused company dedicated to creating unforgettable adventures and curated experiences around the world. The team designs personalized itineraries that reflect individual preferences, from luxury escapes to budget\-friendly trips, across a wide range of destinations and travel styles. TBD emphasizes cultural immersion, discovery of hidden gems, and meaningful exploration for travelers. The company also engages its audience through travel inspiration, exclusive offers, and updates on upcoming tours and packages. Applicants can expect to join a team that is passionate about turning wanderlust into memorable journeys.
 



**Role Description** 
 The Linkedin Growth Intern role at TalesByDora is an internship focused on expanding the company’s presence and engagement on LinkedIn. This hybrid role is based in Ghaziabad, with some flexibility for work from home. Day\-to\-day tasks include creating and scheduling LinkedIn posts, optimizing company and founder profiles, and engaging with followers and relevant communities through comments and messages. The intern will research industry trends and competitor activity, support campaign planning, and track performance metrics to improve reach and conversions. Collaboration with the marketing and content teams is expected to ensure brand\-aligned messaging and consistent visual identity across LinkedIn activities.
 



**Qualifications** 







* Candidates should possess skills in social media content creation, copywriting, and basic graphic design or Canva usage.
* Candidates should possess skills in LinkedIn profile optimization, audience engagement, and community management.
* Candidates should possess skills in social media analytics, basic data interpretation, and reporting on key growth metrics.
* Candidates should possess skills in online research, trend analysis, and competitor benchmarking on digital platforms.
* Candidates should have strong written and verbal communication skills and attention to detail.
* Candidates should be comfortable working in a hybrid setup in Ghaziabad and managing tasks independently with guidance.
* Relevant coursework or interest in marketing, digital media, communications, or tourism is beneficial.
* Prior experience with LinkedIn or other social platforms, even through personal projects, is a plus.
